iPhone Duo offers fast charging, here’s what you’ll need
iPhone Duo can fast charge up to 50 percent battery in just 20 minutes. But you’ll need the right power adapter and cable to get top speeds.
Here’s Apple’s official guidance per this support document:
Wired Fast Charging
To fast charge iPhone Duo up to 50 percent battery in around 20 minutes, use the USB-C cable that came in the box and one of these adapters:
Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max (currently only $34)
A comparable third-party 60W-capable (or greater) adapter that uses Adjustable Voltage Supply (AVS) and supports USB Power Delivery (USB-PD) 3.2 (my recommendation here)
Wireless Fast Charging
To wirelessly charge iPhone Duo up to 50 percent in around 30 minutes, use:
a MagSafe Charger (currently only $30)
a 35W or higher adapter (compatible Apple adapter / compatible Anker adapter)

Third-party chargers can often be a better deal than Apple’s own power adapters. My top recommendation is Anker’s 100W charging brick, which works great not only for iPhones but also more power-hungry Macs and iPads.
That said, the Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter at its reduced price is a great deal for a first-party option.
Additionally, if you want to pick up a longer USB-C cable than what comes in the iPhone Duo box, Apple’s official 2m cable is available at a discount here.
What’s your iPhone fast charging setup? Let us know in the comments.

units.text: Apple is publishing a slew of support documents today corresponding with the launch of iPhone Duo, as it does for every iPhone launch. The support documents cover Touch on iPhone Duo, troubleshooting hinge issues, and much more.
In one support document, Apple outlines what to do if you’re having any of the following problems with the hinge on your iPhone Duo:
Device won’t open or close completely
Unexpected noise while opening or closing the device
Loose hinge
Bent or broken hinge
Enclosure damage that affects hinge operation
Apple also has a support document outlining the software accommodations for using a case on iPhone Duo that partially covers the left edge of the outer display:

After applying iPhone Duo Case, a message appears on the display of iPhone Duo with the option to adjust the screen size to accommodate for the case. Follow the onscreen instructions to make the changes.
You can adjust the screen at any time: open Settings and tap Display & Brightness. Turn on Shift Left Edge. This shifts the outer display content to accommodate the front portion of the case.

The iPhone Duo launches today, starting at $1,999, with a 5.4-inch outer display that unfolds into a 7.6-inch inner display. Early reviews present a mixed picture of a device that brings fresh ideas to the iPhone, but asks users to accept some significant compromises.

The matte inner display has emerged as a particular highlight, reducing reflections and making the crease less noticeable while providing more space for reading, watching videos, editing photos, and multitasking. Premium construction and performance also make a positive impression, but the software experience is less consistent. Unoptimized apps, wasted screen space, and unfamiliar controls can make the larger display feel underused.

Reviewers are also divided over how comfortably iPhone Duo handles quick, everyday tasks. Some find the outer screen perfectly adequate for messaging and quick interactions, while others consider it to be restrictive. units.text: Lighting effects can make or break your TV room, gaming setup, etc. SwitchBot’s RGBICWW Light Bars take a different approach from most products, with dedicated cool-white and warm-white LEDs alongside the color zones. The end result means real white light for work and reading, and 12-zone RGBIC color for movies. It all works over Wi-Fi/Matter as well, so you don’t need a hub.
HomeKit Weekly is a series focused on smart home accessories, automation tips and tricks, and everything to do with Apple’s smart home framework.

RGB color mixing can produce something that technically looks white on a wall, but it’s not the same quality of light you’d want to read or work under for hours. If you work in an office building, you know what I am talking about. SwitchBot’s RGBICWW Light Bars use separate cool-white and warm-white LEDs that produce actual white light with adjustable color temperature that can go from 2200K up to 6500K, and they dim as well. It can produce up to 800 lumens across the pair.

On the color side, each bar has six independently controllable RGBIC zones, so you have 12 zones across the pair. This lets you run multi-color gradients rather than a single color across the entire bar. There are 26 preset dynamic effects and six music-reactive modes powered by a built-in microphone, so you don’t need a separate sensor to sync the lights to sound.
Matter over Wi-Fi

The light bars connect to Apple Home natively over Matter via Wi-Fi without needing a SwitchBot Hub. The integration covers the basics: on/off, brightness, color temperature, and color control via the Home app or Siri.

The deeper color zone control, music modes, dynamic effects, and scene building all live in the SwitchBot app rather than Apple Home, which is standard for Matter accessories at this level of feature complexity. A wired physical controller is also included for quick changes to the lights as well. I am a big fan of when smart home products offer a physical button option as well.

The lights include built-in magnets so you can attach the bars directly to compatible metal surfaces, with adhesive being an option as well. They can be mounted horizontally, vertically, rear-mounted behind a monitor or TV, or set upright with the included desktop stands.
Wrap up

SwitchBot built just about everything you’d want here. The attention to color detail is fantastic. Matter over Wi-Fi means you can buy it and have it directly connected to Apple Home/HomeKit without a hub, while still having flexibility for the future.
You can buy the SwitchBot RGBICWW Light Bars from Amazon.

units.text: iPhone Duo is officially out in the wild, and users keep discovering new details about the device. The latest: there’s a hidden trick that makes opening Control Center significantly easier.
iPhone Duo’s Control Center can be opened in new, more reachable way
When iPhone Duo reviews dropped earlier this week, one common complaint I saw is that in left-handed use, opening Control Center can be a pain.
Like on other iPhones, you open Control Center by swiping down from the top-right corner.
If you’re using iPhone Duo two-handed, that’s not a problem. Or if it’s in your right hand, it might be slightly awkward but still ultimately fine.
In left-handed use though, even when folded, the device’s extra-wide design makes Control Center more of a challenge to open.
Except it turns out, Apple added a hidden trick that solves that.
As Stephen Robles shows in a video on X, you can instead just tap the new Battery/Wi-Fi/Cellular icon to open Control Center.
Getting to Control Center on iPhone Duo is *the best* pic.twitter.com/jvd1mw64dR
— Stephen Robles (@stephenrobles) October 23, 2026

This shortcut is much more reachable than a top-right corner swipe. And as Robles demonstrates, when you have a Live Activity running the button moves even further down the screen to become even more reachable.
It’s one of the many unique design implementations iPhone Duo introduces.

If you already have an ‌Apple Pencil‌ 1, ‌Apple Pencil‌ 2, or ‌Apple Pencil‌ Pro to use with an iPad, you're going to be disappointed to hear they won't work with the ‌iPhone Duo‌. The ‌iPhone Duo‌ only works with the ‌Apple Pencil‌ with USB-C, which is $79 from Apple, but you can get it from Amazon for $69.

The ‌Apple Pencil‌ Pro attaches to and pairs with iPads magnetically, but the ‌iPhone Duo‌ has to be paired with the USB-C ‌Apple Pencil‌ using a USB-C cable. ‌Apple Pencil‌ support is being added in iOS 27.2, which is available in beta right now.

Once paired, the ‌Apple Pencil‌ works with the ‌iPhone Duo‌ like it works with an ‌iPad‌. You can write or draw, and there is a setting to turn on palm rejection. You can use the ‌Apple Pencil‌ on both the inner and outer displays. The ‌Apple Pencil‌ can attach magnetically to the Duo's hinge for storage, but it doesn't charge that way.
Compared with the ‌Apple Pencil‌ Pro, the USB-C ‌Apple Pencil‌ doesn't have pressure sensitivity, double-tap, or squeeze.

The ‌Apple Pencil‌ tip can leave lines on the Duo's display, but the lines wipe away with a polishing cloth. Permanent damage is unlikely, but Apple does have an ‌iPhone Duo‌ cover layer replacement option that's $19 if you have AppleCare+ and $49 if you don't.

If you want to take notes or make quick sketches with the ‌iPhone Duo‌, the ‌Apple Pencil‌ with USB-C could be worth the cost, but it's not quite as useful as it is on an ‌iPad‌ due to the limited screen size.

units.text: Apple Music is still celebrating the iPod, although only if you know exactly where to look. Here's where to find it.

On October 23, 2026, the iPhone Duo shipped, but 25 years earlier, to the day, Steve Jobs announced the iPod. It's been a remarkable road from one device to the other, but even as the spotlight is on the iPhone Duo, Apple has launched an almost fully working virtual iPod.

"Launched" is possibly not the right word, as you have to either know where to look, or manage to get Apple Music to return an error message. That's where this iPod is, it is hidden on the Apple Music online site.
So not the app, but the online version. It's the one for Apple Music subscribers who are stuck on PCs at work.
To go have a look on an iPhone or iPad, long-press on this address, https://music.apple.com/404 and choose Open. Be sure not to choose Open in Music, as that simply takes you to the Apple Music app.
You can press and hold on that URL to see a preview. That's also possible on macOS, but to get the full-size iPod on a Mac, right-click on the link and choose Open.
Maybe Apple has always had a virtual iPod that it made for Steve Jobs (right) - image credit: Apple.

What you now get is a typical web 404 page, except alongside the usual "page not found" message, it says "Give this a spin instead." The text, written in Apple's old favorite font Garamond, is next to an image of an iPod.
It's gorgeous. Plus in every way bar one, it even works like an old iPod.
So you have a click wheel and you can scroll through settings or music. And such a lot of music, probably getting on for 1,000 tracks.

You can scroll to choose any of them, and as you scroll, you hear the once-famous, now forgotten, but so very welcome click. The iPod clicks as you scroll, and then you can press on its center button to select and play a track.
It is so thoroughly lifelike that if you select a song, it will appear to play it. So you get a progress bar through the song.

The only thing AppleInsider couldn't make it do was have that track be audible. Doubtlessly every song is in Apple Music, but perhaps the rights don't include letting it be played where you don't have to be a subscriber.
It's not as if many people are going to stumble across it, though. This is an error page and realistically you're only ever going to find it if someone tells you.
So thank you Edward Munn, whose blog reported it first.

To be fair, neither he nor we can be certain that this error page was added specifically for this 25th anniversary of the iPod. Maybe it's been this way for a long time, but just in case and also just in case it goes away, do be sure to try it out now.
Funny. When Apple killed off the last iPod, it did so with a press release that rankled because it was trying to make it sound like a good thing. "The music lives on," it said.
But 25 years after the launch of the iPod and four years since it died, maybe Apple had a point.

units.text: In a new post on the WebKit blog highlighting what’s new in Safari 27.1, Apple’s Jen Simmons said the company is exploring ways to let websites make better use of the iPhone Duo’s outer display. Here are the details.
Apple knows Safari isn’t making full use of iPhone Duo’s outer display

One issue singled out in multiple iPhone Duo reviews (including ours) was the fact that Safari’s right-aligned controls take up a significant portion of the outer display’s limited screen space, leaving websites with an unusually narrow area to show their content.
Here’s what Chance Miller had to say about this in his review, published earlier this week:

But the awkwardness of the iPhone’s 5.4-inch outer display shows up in Safari. The web simply isn’t optimized for this form factor. I’ll talk more about this later, but the right-aligned controls on iPhone Duo eat into the usable screen real estate in Safari especially.

I can see why Apple chose the design it did for Safari on the iPhone Duo. I don’t think overlapping the controls with the website would’ve made sense. Still, scrolling in Safari is one of the best examples of something that’s better on the inner screen.
For new iPhone Duo users who have also been frustrated by this issue, Apple’s Jen Simmons shared some good news today.

In a post highlighting what’s new in Safari 27.1, including how websites adapt to the iPhone Duo’s different screen sizes and folding positions, Simmons acknowledged that websites currently can’t extend behind the controls on the device’s outer display, and said Apple is exploring ways to address that limitation.
From her post:

We would like to give web designers and developers the ability to design and use that space in more creative ways. Perhaps you want to extend your header background across the full width of the display, for example. It might seem like there’s just one obvious way to make this possible, but really there are many possibilities.

Simmons went on to explain that simply using the HTML viewport meta tag with viewport-fit="cover" to extend websites behind Safari’s controls could cause problems, because many websites don’t properly account for those areas, potentially leaving important content obscured.
Instead, she invited developers to share their ideas as Apple explores a better approach:
We are investigating if there’s a better way to accomplish the same result — something more foolproof and perhaps easier for you to use. If you have ideas, we’d love to hear them. And stay tuned.
If you’re a web developer and have ideas on how Apple could address this limitation, you can read the full WebKit post for details on how to share your feedback.

units.text: Apple Closes French Stores Ahead of Further Protests
Seven Apple stores across France are closed on today, as the country prepares for another round of demonstrations a week after looters targeted two of the company's locations.

As first spotted by MacGeneration, the affected stores include all three Paris locations: Champs-Élysées, Opéra, and Marché Saint-Germain. Apple's website also lists Saturday closures for Bordeaux Sainte-Catherine, Lille, Strasbourg, and Aix-en-Provence.

The closures are likely a precaution to protect employees and stores during the protests. The seven locations have entrances directly onto the street, while Apple's stores inside shopping malls are expected to operate normally during the period.
Apple's Lille and Bordeaux stores were looted during the unrest on October 17 unrest. Both were among many businesses targeted across France.

The demonstrations concern rising living costs and poor conditions in schools, according to the Associated Press. Hundreds of thousands are said to have protested peacefully on October 17, but violence and looting broke out in several cities.

Following the looting, reports emerged of stolen iPhones displaying warnings that they had been disabled and were being tracked, along with instructions to return them to their stores of origin. A video shared by Le Signal purportedly shows the message.

The three Paris stores, Bordeaux Sainte-Catherine, and Aix-en-Provence list Sunday opening hours of noon to 6 p.m. Apple's Lille and Strasbourg pages show that those stores will remain closed on Sunday and reopen on Monday.

units.text: iPhone Duo 2 提前曝光：FaceID、操作按钮都要回来了？
iPhone Duo 正式开售，大伙都去店里摸过、或者已经拿到新机了吗？
15999 元起步的国行售价，丝毫没有浇灭大家对这台折叠屏的期待，线下门店预约爆满，官网订单更是排到了明年 1 月下旬。
但就在大家沉浸在开箱的新鲜感中时，二代的消息却猝不及防地来了。
彭博社记者 Mark Gurman 在最新一期《Power On》播客中爆料：苹果内部已经在测试 iPhone Duo 2 的原型机，有两个关键变化——外屏屏下 Face ID，以及操作按钮（Action Button）的回归。
一个月前，外界还推测 Face ID 至少要等到第三代折叠屏才有可能解决；现在，最新的爆料显示，它的回归或许比我们想得更早一些。
让解锁再次隐形
在形态和交互上，iPhone Duo 这次跟以往的 iPhone 比起来不可谓不大。
在首发评测一周多的体验下来，屏幕开合时的细腻阻尼、半折悬停时的优雅动画，以及把操控留给边角、把大屏留给内容的排布方式，都让爱范儿印象深刻。
但回到最基础的日常使用，它身上也充满了一些「很不 iPhone」的地方，最直接的便是从 Face ID 换回了 Touch ID。
两种解锁方式孰优孰劣见仁见智，但有一点是确定的——Face ID 带来了更「无感」的解锁体验。
图｜第一代 iPhone Duo：外屏 5.4 英寸，展开后为 7.6 英寸。Apple
刚从直板 iPhone 换到 Duo 时，这种习惯的惯性尤为明显。
我们在选购指南里提到了这样的场景：用习惯 Face ID 后换到 iPhone Duo，每次按亮屏幕，总会时不时下意识盯着屏幕等它识别人脸。
拇指往上一滑，手机并没有乖乖地进入桌面——愣了一下才反应过来，原来手指还得挪去侧边的电源键。
自从 Face ID 伴随 iPhone X 面世，苹果就把「身份认证」做成了一个几乎隐形的背景动作：
图｜Apple
拿起手机、看向屏幕、自然上滑，系统在视线对齐的瞬间就完成了验证，用户不需要为解锁去做任何多余的心理预设或手指动作。
但换成侧边 Touch ID 后，意味着你必须重新带着明确的意图，把手指主动移过去「够」机身侧边那颗狭长的小按键。
偏偏在 iPhone Duo 折叠时 84.1 毫米、展开时 164.6 毫米宽的机身上，这么一个「够」的动作格外要命。
双手握持阅读时手指托在机身底部两侧，拇指远离侧边高处的电源键；如果换成左手单手握持，就只能靠食指或者中指去盲摸。
侧边电容式指纹受限于按键尺寸，传感器面积天然有限，对接触位置和手指状态极其敏感。
遇上容易出手汗、或者本身指纹纹路较浅的人，识别受阻是高频发生的日常体验。
退回侧边 Touch ID，更像是一种物理空间逼迫下的权宜之计。展开后仅 5.2 毫米的超薄机身，让苹果在极致轻薄和完整体验之间不得不先选前者。
外屏单侧内部可用纵深只有 5 毫米左右，扣除 OLED 屏幕面板、铰链机械件和中框结构，留给传感器内部纵深的厚度极为有限，根本容纳不下现有的 Face ID 光学模组。
退而求其次，把 Touch ID 做进侧边电源键，其实是现阶段兼顾紧凑空间、同时在合上与展开状态下都能实现一致解锁的最优解。
但显然，苹果自己也对这套取舍带来的牺牲门清。
二代原型机早早把外屏屏下 Face ID 纳入测试，正是为了补齐这台折叠屏的短板，重新让这个形态融入 iPhone 近十年的无感交互体系里。
只不过，把 Face ID 藏进屏幕底下，并不是一件简单的事。
iPhone 18 Pro 的拆解就很能说明问题：哪怕机身厚度接近 8 毫米，苹果也没能做到全套屏下，仅仅是将红外摄像头单独藏进了屏幕底下。
图｜显微镜下，iPhone 18 Pro 红外摄像头上方的显示像素留出了透光间隙。iFixit
为了让光线穿透，苹果甚至不得不专门抽掉一部分屏幕像素，才勉强抠出一条透光缝隙。
直板机尚且要这样大费周章，放到单侧厚度只有 5 毫米左右的折叠屏里，难度可想而知。
图｜iPhone Air 上的 Action Button（来源：AppleMagazine）
另一个在二代原型机上测试的改动，是操作按钮（Action Button）的回归。
第一代 Duo 有个令人费解的取舍：苹果宁愿把那颗复杂的相机控制键留着，却拿掉了操作按钮。
就我自己而言，长年把它当成「一键记账」的快捷入口；身边很多朋友也习惯了用它随手扫码、开手电筒，或是进会议室前隔着裤兜盲摸静音。
换到 Duo 后，这些肌肉记忆都彻底失效了。想静音或者触发快捷指令，只能老老实实亮屏、下拉控制中心。
虽然功能都在，但那种「不用看屏幕、不用掏手机」的盲操体验，在屏幕的软按键里终究是找不回来的。
尝鲜，还是再等等？
既然现在曝出二代会有许多改进，那买初代 Duo 的机主会成为大怨种吗？那倒未必。
如果你担心手里的新机转眼就过时，大可放心。从实验室里的工程验证，到真正摆上货架送到消费者手里，中间还隔着相当漫长的周期。
按照郭明錤与彭博社此前的供应链追踪，第二代 iPhone Duo 预计要在 2027 年才会推出，更大尺寸的后续机型甚至排到了 2028 年。
关于 Face ID，Gurman 在播客中也预期可能需要一至两次迭代才能真正落地。
面对眼下的购买选择，几种不同的「等一等」指向的其实是截然不同的诉求。
1. 等首批供货缓解，等的是价格回归正常。
从开售首日的情况看，虽然官方发货排到明年 1 月，但二级市场的溢价已经大幅回落，甚至有黄牛因为行情变动太快而暂停收货。
随着后续各渠道陆续到货，为了抢跑几个月而付出的高额加价会迅速消退。
2. 等第三方应用适配，等的是让这块 7.6 英寸内屏更好用。
在爱范儿前期的首发测试中，大量常用主流应用其实都还停留在等比放大或居中留黑边的初级兼容状态，「微信不适配」甚至一度冲上热搜第一。
但主流大厂的跟进速度比想象中更快——就在今天开售当天，微信火速推送了 8.0.80 版本更新。
爱范儿第一时间做了上手实测，新版在内屏展开后已经支持左右分栏显示，大屏效率有了质的提升。
给开发者一点时间，软件体验就会迅速补齐，这也是我们在首发评测中建议多数普通用户「不妨稍等等」的原因。
3. 而等外屏 Face ID、等操作按钮回归，等的则是下一代硬件。
产能和生态可以追赶，但物理限制没法走捷径。屏下 Face ID 的工程答卷，只能留给下一代去揭晓了。
如果你还在犹豫，不妨去线下店里亲自把屏幕展开、合上，试试侧边按键解锁与按键操作的顺手程度，这能帮你看清自己是否愿意接纳这些妥协。
如果你最在意的恰好就是无感的 Face ID、随时盲按的操作按钮和长焦镜头，那么二代的爆料确实给足了期待：不妨把钱包留在口袋里，多等它一两代。

units.text: 快科技10月24日消息，据海外论坛和小红书多人反馈，苹果iPhone Duo屏幕存在不小的问题，很多人遇到了开箱就爆线开裂的问题。
汇总照片显示几乎全部故障都集中在铰链正上方，多数表现为屏幕一侧浮现一条亮像素线。
一名澳洲用户称设备到手约6小时、开合不到20次，向朋友展示展开时先感到内铰链下方异样，随后听到清晰的咔嚓声，屏幕随即沿铰链裂开，内屏表面与外部铰链均无磕碰或夹痕，他前往Apple Store后苹果直接为其更换了故障机。
国内也有用户称，正常展开屏幕时听到咔嚓一声，折叠处出现一道约3厘米黑色竖裂痕，另有一条较细裂痕贯穿屏幕右半，而且目前已经出现多例类似损坏。
目前来看，应该是iPhone Duo的铰链存在一些问题，但规模不算大，有可能是装配公差导致，而非设计问题，具体情况还有待后续观察。
如果苹果售后检测确认非人为导致，将会给用户更换新机。

units.text: Crackgate? iPhone Duo Owners Report Screens Breaking Along the Hinge

Some iPhone Duos are already experiencing hinge issues that cause display cracks, based on photos shared on Reddit and the MacRumors forums. Almost all of the display faults are right along the hinge, and most result in a line of bright pixels across one side of the screen.
An iPhone Duo owner in Australia said his device cracked after being opened fewer than 20 times, and there was no visible damage beforehand.

Had my iPhone Duo for about six hours and had probably opened it fewer than 20 times. I was showing it to a friend, and as I opened it, I felt something around the internal hinge, underneath the screen.

As I continued opening it, I heard an audible crack, and the screen broke right along the hinge. There were no marks or damage on the inner screen's surface or the external hinge to suggest anything had been caught or damaged.

The user visited an Apple Store, and Apple replaced the broken device right away. Apple is likely collecting defective iPhone Duos to research points of failure, and that research could lead to manufacturing improvements to reduce future issues.

There are several images of broken displays from demo devices in China, where the ‌iPhone Duo‌ launched hours ahead of the U.S. The backstory for most of the images is unknown, and it's possible user damage is a factor. Some reviewers who got an ‌iPhone Duo‌ early subjected it to folding tests and didn't experience screen issues, but that's a small sample.

With so many people getting iPhone Duos today, some failures are expected. It isn't known how widespread the issue is or whether we'll see an uptick in complaints over time. Hinge failures from normal use should be covered under the one-year warranty, and customers receiving an ‌iPhone Duo‌ today will also have two weeks to make a return.

units.text: 微软计划于2027年1月为 macOS 版 Microsoft Edge 推出扩展稳定版（Extended Stable）渠道，让使用苹果电脑的企业客户也能够采用更缓慢、更加可预测的浏览器更新节奏。这项变化主要面向需要统一管理大量设备、对软件兼容性和更新流程有严格要求的组织。
根据微软产品路线图于2026年10月23日更新的信息，macOS 设备管理者将能够选择 Edge 扩展稳定版渠道。该渠道的大版本更新周期为八周，相比之下，Edge 普通稳定版从版本152开始，已经调整为每两周发布一个大版本。扩展稳定版的目标是让企业拥有更多时间测试新版本、评估兼容性，并在正式部署前完成内部验证。
对于普通个人用户而言，浏览器更新通常意味着更快获得新功能和性能改进；但对企业IT部门来说，频繁更新也可能增加软件测试、技术支持和应用兼容性管理的工作量。尤其是在大型组织中，内部业务系统、浏览器扩展、身份验证工具以及各类办公软件往往存在复杂的依赖关系。如果浏览器版本变化过快，企业就需要投入更多资源确认现有系统是否仍能正常运行。
扩展稳定版正是为解决这一问题而设计。它不会像普通稳定版那样频繁切换主要版本，而是将新功能和较大范围的版本变化集中在更长的周期内，让管理员能够提前规划部署时间。微软此前已经在其他受支持的环境中提供这一渠道，此次计划则是将相同的更新管理选择扩展至 macOS 平台。
需要注意的是，八周更新周期并不意味着企业可以完全忽略安全更新。扩展稳定版同样会接收安全修复和维护更新，其核心区别在于主要版本的发布节奏更慢，而不是放弃安全维护。微软也明确建议企业通过试点设备提前测试新版本，并根据实际兼容性情况逐步扩大部署范围。
这项调整还与 Edge 整体发布策略的变化有关。微软在2026年宣布，从 Edge 152 开始，普通稳定版将改为每两周发布一个大版本，以便更快交付功能和平台改进。对于需要更长测试周期的组织，扩展稳定版则继续维持每八周更新一次的节奏。两种渠道因此分别服务于不同需求：普通稳定版侧重更快获得新功能，扩展稳定版则侧重部署的可预测性和变更管理。
按照目前公布的计划，macOS 版 Edge 扩展稳定版预计于2027年1月正式提供。不过，这一日期属于微软路线图中的计划时间，后续仍可能调整。该功能主要针对受管理的企业环境，并非专门为普通家庭用户设计，因此一般用户无需为了获得更慢的更新周期而立即采取行动。
从实际意义来看，这项变化补齐了企业跨平台管理 Edge 时的一项重要选择。对于同时使用 Windows 和 macOS 设备的组织而言，能够在不同平台上采用更一致的浏览器更新策略，有助于简化测试、部署和技术支持流程。随着企业软件环境日益复杂，浏览器厂商不仅需要加快功能交付，也需要为重视稳定性的客户提供足够灵活的更新机制。

units.text: Apple Released iOS 27.1 for iPhone Duo Only
Apple this week released the full and final version of iOS 27.1, but it is only available for the foldable iPhone Duo that launched today.

iPhone Duo already ships with iOS 27.1 preinstalled, but users need to update to a newer build of iOS 27.1 while setting up the device, and that newer build is available for download as an IPSW file as of Thursday. Apple's release notes for the newer build simply mention unspecified "bug fixes for your iPhone." iOS 27.1 has no security fixes.

Apple jumped ahead to an iOS 27.2 beta for all other compatible iPhone models, and the iOS 27.2 Release Candidate is compatible with the iPhone Duo too, so all of the models will be able to upgrade to iOS 27.2 for consistency.
iOS 27.1 was likely kept exclusive to the iPhone Duo so that Apple could prevent certain Duo-specific software features from leaking before the device launched.
iOS 27.2 is expected to be released next week.

units.text: 苹果本周正式推出iOS 27.1最终正式版系统更新，但该版本并不会面向所有兼容机型开放，而是仅限于当天正式发售的折叠屏手机iPhone Duo使用。
根据苹果的安排，iPhone Duo出厂时已经预装iOS 27.1。不过在用户完成设备初始化设置过程中，仍需要升级到一个更新版本的iOS 27.1构建版本。苹果已于此前开放该版本的IPSW固件下载，供用户和开发者获取。
苹果公布的更新说明相当简短，仅提到“针对你的iPhone进行了错误修复”。与此同时，该版本并未包含任何安全修复内容，重点主要集中在常规稳定性改进方面。
对于其他兼容iPhone机型，苹果并未同步推送iOS 27.1。相反，公司直接将开发进度推进到iOS 27.2，并已向用户发布iOS 27.2 Release Candidate（RC）候选版本。该版本同样兼容iPhone Duo，这意味着包括折叠屏新机在内的所有受支持机型，后续都能够统一升级到iOS 27.2。
业内认为，苹果之所以让iOS 27.1成为iPhone Duo独占版本，很可能是为了在新设备正式上市前避免部分专属软件功能提前泄露。由于iPhone Duo采用全新的折叠屏设计，并针对大尺寸可折叠显示屏开发了专门的软件体验，因此苹果在产品发布前选择限制系统适用范围，以加强保密工作。
随着iPhone Duo正式发售，iOS 27.1也完成了其阶段性使命。按照目前的计划，苹果预计将在下周向用户推出iOS 27.2正式版，届时包括iPhone Duo在内的所有兼容设备都将进入统一的软件版本体系。

evidence.title: 全网首台！iPhone Duo 256GB硬核扩容至2TB：存储焦虑没了

units.text: 快科技10月24日消息，iPhone Duo上市还不到2天时间，已有民间大神将其扩容，B站UP主万维创芯-老罗带来了iPhone Duo扩容视频，手机从256GB扩容至2TB，号称是全网第一家。
从视频来看，整个扩容过程并不简单。操作者先用CNC工具将原有的256GB硬盘打磨掉，再用烙铁处理焊盘，接着为2TB硬盘植上183度中温锡，最后进行安装。
安装过程中需要用风枪加热硬盘，待锡熔化之后，轻推硬盘使其复位即可。整个过程对工具和手法都有较高要求，并非普通用户能够轻易尝试。
众所周知，iPhone不同存储版本之间的价差很大，网友也调侃“苹果的闪存是金子做的”。以iPhone Duo为例，256GB版本售价15999元，2TB版本售价26499元，两者相差超过1万元。巨大的价差，让不少预算有限又想要大容量的用户把目光投向第三方扩容。
所谓扩容，就是通过更换存储芯片，把低容量机型改成高容量。相比官方高配版本，第三方扩容的费用通常只有几千元，看起来更划算。
但扩容的风险同样明显。首先，私自拆机和改动主板会直接导致手机失去官方保修，后续出现任何问题都只能自费处理。其次，扩容涉及主板焊接和芯片匹配，工艺不过关容易引发死机、发热甚至无法开机。
此外，扩容机在二手市场的残值也会大打折扣。对于仍在保修期内的iPhone，不建议尝试扩容。
